messages:
clare: Opened a PR to tighten Troubleshooting > Rate limits & timeouts guidance. Need quick reviews on wording about 429 vs fallback behavior and a tiny Go snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/527
noah: Reviewing. Two quick calls: 1) make distinction between burst 429s (very short) and sustained capacity 429s obvious, 2) highlight 413 behavior for over-context.
clare: Draft phrasing for fallback: 'When routing policy permits, Redwood may transparently route to a compatible, lower-capacity model under load; otherwise requests receive 429 with Retry-After.' Ask runtime for sign-off.
runtime-team: Confirmed. That phrasing is approved for public docs. We'll also emit header `x-rw-fallback: true` when fallback was used.
noah: Add note that `Retry-After` is seconds and we sometimes return `Retry-After: 0` for immediate-burst candidates; recommend min backoff (200ms) to reduce thundering-herd.
clare: Added. Also included a tiny Go retry example using context and exponential backoff.
noah: Suggest include Abort/timeout example for JS and a Python manual-retry snippet for non-idempotent streaming cases. Keep them minimal.
clare: Done. Example curl added to show header inspection:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# check 'Retry-After' and 'x-rw-fallback' headers
```
docs-bot: Reminder: add a changelog entry under docs/changes and file a follow-up for an on-prem migration YAML for Dedicated customers.
clare: Filed follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/812. Ready to request editorial review after minor link fixes.
noah: LGTM once console links are updated and runtime sign-off is explicitly mentioned in PR description.
clare: Thanks — will update and request review. :sparkles:
